meaning:
κοσμικός, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος)
1. pertaining to the world or universe.
2. of this world, earthly. Heb.9:1.
3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, Tit.2:12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
